tasks.short: Determine reinforcing-bar requirements from approved instructions.

steps.what: Retrieve actual current blueprints, sketches and reinforcing-bar instructions
Determine sizes, shapes and locations of reinforcing rods from actual approved instructions
inputs: actual drawing bar marks, dimensions and layout
outputs: actual interpreted bar requirements and counted occurrences

steps.what: Enter actual rod requirements in the existing reinforcement takeoff tool {OTHER}
inputs: actual interpreted bar requirements and counted occurrences
actual source bar schedule fields when available
outputs: checked actual bar mark, size, shape, location and count fields

steps.what: Calculate quantities of reinforcing rods from checked actual bar counts and dimensions
inputs: checked actual bar mark, size, shape, location and count fields

steps.what: Check final quantities, sizes, shapes and locations against actual approved reinforcement instructions
inputs: actual interpreted bar requirements and counted occurrences

steps.what: Save the checked final reinforcing-bar requirement record

tasks.design: Configure current drawing links in {DOCS}, source bar-field reuse and fixed quantity formulas in the reinforcement takeoff tool {OTHER}. The worker interprets actual approved instructions, checks bar requirements and final quantities and saves the existing takeoff record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Takeoff can repeat source navigation, bar-field copying and quantity arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native revision links, exact bar-field reuse and fixed formulas can reduce those operations.
tasks.still_hard: Drawing interpretation, revisions, congested locations and ambiguous oral instructions require human checks.
tasks.human_edge: The worker recognises that a repeated mark or dimension does not necessarily describe the same installed bar.
tasks.altitude: Less takeoff repetition; structural design and field interpretation authority stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reinforcement takeoff fields and formulas can reuse approved bar data and sum quantities; they do not infer a safe structural design or replace drawing interpretation.

assumptions: Actual drawing/detailing owner supplies approved revision and any structured bar mark, diameter, shape, dimensions, count and location. Worker verifies source in s1, interprets and counts actual occurrences in s2 and manually captures unsupported fields and oral instructions in retained s3.

Only exact repeated fields and arithmetic are eligible. No free model extraction, automatic drawing interpretation or paper digitisation is assumed. Missing structured source data reduces s3 eligibility.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Native fields/formulas first; already automated takeoff earns zero saving. Existing takeoff records are included only where the worker actually maintains them; omit absent records and reweight.

Save remains one percent and uses the existing final requirements check. Ordering, bending or installing bars is a separate actual authorised action with no saving claimed here; no design changes are introduced.
unknowns: Which actual bar fields are repeated?
Does this worker maintain the takeoff record?
research_questions: Can approved field reuse reduce copying after full drawing and revision checking?

incremental.description: Maintain actual revision links, bar field mappings and quantity formulas.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final reinforcing-bar requirement record and exact job/pour destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 navigation + 20*0.50 repeated fields + 15 arithmetic = 31; minus 1 upkeep = 30. Half eligible gives 15.5 minus 1 = 14.5. Drawing interpretation, primary counting, final checks and save remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The worker retains interpretation of approved reinforcement instructions while actual repeated takeoff entry and arithmetic may shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Validate actual takeoff duplication without changing structural design or reducing field checks.
